title: Weighted Empirical Risk Minimization for Machine Learning under Long-Range Dependence: Exact Pathwise Rates and Learning-Error Geometry
abstract: arXiv:2609.10767v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We develop an exact almost-sure learning theory for smooth parametric models trained by regularly weighted empirical risk minimization on long-range dependent data. The training observations are generated from a fixed finite window of a stationary Gaussian sequence, and the sample weights are regularly varying. If the loss gradient at the population minimizer has Wiener-chaos rank $m$ and a nonzero low-frequency coefficient, then, in the long-memory interior regime, the finite-lag score reduces on the iterated-logarithm scale to a single weighted Hermite chaos. This yields an almost-sure Bahadur representation, an exact limsup law for the learned parameter, and, for $m\ge2$, the functional cluster set of the complete learning trajectory. translated_title: 长程依赖下机器学习的加权经验风险最小化：精确逐路径速率与学习误差几何
translated_abstract: 我们为在长程依赖数据上通过正则加权经验风险最小化训练的光滑参数模型建立了一个精确的几乎必然学习理论。训练观测由平稳高斯序列的固定有限窗口生成，样本权重呈正则变化。如果损失函数在总体极小值点处的梯度具有维纳混沌秩 $m$ 且低频系数非零，那么在长记忆内部区域内，有限滞后得分在重对数尺度上可约化为单一的加权Hermite混沌。由此得到了几乎必然的Bahadur表示、学习参数的精确limsup定律，以及当 $m\ge2$ 时完整学习轨迹的函数聚类集。多项式学习指数由记忆参数和混沌秩决定，且在容许的幂加权下保持不变，而精确的逐路径常数和聚类几何（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文建立了长程依赖数据下加权经验风险最小化的精确几乎必然学习理论，证明多项式学习指数由记忆参数和维纳混沌秩共同决定且对容许幂加权不变，并给出了学习参数的精确逐路径收敛定律和轨迹聚类几何。
en_tdlr: This paper develops an exact almost-sure learning theory for weighted empirical risk minimization under long-range dependence, showing that the polynomial learning exponent is determined by the memory parameter and Wiener-chaos rank and is invariant under admissible power weighting, while providing exact pathwise laws and cluster geometry for the learned parameter trajectory.
